items.question: In the UAE, what minimum distance in metres must shisha cafes without a special licence keep from residential areas, schools and mosques?
items.gold: Shisha cafes, except those with a special licence, are banned from operating within 150 metres of residential areas, schools and mosques.
items.fact: Shisha cafes must stay 150 metres from homes, schools, mosques

items.question: Under UAE Wadeema's Law (Federal Law No. 3 of 2016 on child rights), can a tobacco seller ask a buyer to prove they are eighteen?
items.gold: Yes, the seller has the right to ask the purchaser to provide evidence of reaching the age of eighteen.
items.fact: Wadeema's Law lets sellers request proof of buyer's age eighteen
